description: Section 16, case 3 (report burst). Nearby events: M=5.6 at 10:00 and M=4.2 at 10:20, then a late report of M=6.1 that occurred at 09:55. Policy: among candidates (larger magnitude, strictly earlier, within W hours and R km) choose the largest magnitude, then the closest in time, then the closest in distance, then the smallest id.
